worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.summary: Uses psychic power to plant one of your major statuses on the target: you are cured only if it lands, and it fails if the target already has a major status or is immune to yours.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.use.0: Hand your burn/poison/paralysis to the opponent
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.use.1: Clear your own burden after a status move
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.use.2: Throw a damage-over-time status back in a war of attrition
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.descriptio: Cast on one opponent within %1$s blocks that has no major status and is in sight; it cannot be used while you carry no major status. One of your major statuses is planted on it, and you are cured only if it lands. If the target is immune to that status nothing is transferred and you keep it.
Transfer strength %1$s: the status lasts this multiple of its remaining time on the target.
%1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.deep.on: Deep seed: the planted status lasts longer, and poison deepens to toxic; costs +3 wind-up and x1.35 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.deep.off: Light push: 3 ticks less wind-up and x0.9 cooldown, for clearing your own status more often, but it does not take deep root.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.timing: Cast on one opponent; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery, %5$s s cooldown from commit, current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.growth.0: At level %1$s the transfer strength rises to %2$s and the cooldown from commit drops to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.growth.1: At level %1$s the transfer strength rises to %2$s and the cooldown drops again to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychoshift.preference: On = deep seed: the planted status lasts longer and poison deepens to toxic, costing +3 wind-up and x1.35 cooldown. Off = light push: 3 ticks less wind-up and x0.9 cooldown for clearing your own status often. Depth trades against cast frequency.
The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means passing it from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
On: do not cast when the target is immune to the status, to avoid a wasted cast. Off: push it as long as the target has no status, leaving immunity to the cast.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to transfer the status. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
world_combat.move.psychoshift.text.immun: The target is immune to that status
